name: rednote-gate
description: MCP server for one throwaway RedNote (Xiaohongshu) account. Reads run directly; every write waits for a human Approve click.
author: Yash Shelar

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium && npm run build && npm run login && npm run connect
scripts.stop: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),f=require('path').join(process.env.RN_DATA_DIR||'data','lock');try{const pid=+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');process.kill(pid,'SIGTERM');console.log('Stopped the rednote-gate service (pid '+pid+').')}catch{console.log('The rednote-gate service is not running.')}"
scripts.connect: command -v claude >/dev/null || { echo 'Claude Code CLI not found. Add the server by hand: see README.'; exit 0; }; claude mcp get rednote-gate >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'rednote-gate is already connected to Claude Code.' || claude mcp add --scope user rednote-gate -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js"
scripts.live: npm run stop --silent && claude mcp remove rednote-gate -s user >/dev/null 2>&1; claude mcp add rednote-gate --scope user -e RN_DRY_RUN=0 -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js" && echo 'rednote-gate is LIVE: approved items will be published. Open a new Claude Code session.'
scripts.dry: npm run stop --silent && claude mcp remove rednote-gate -s user >/dev/null 2>&1; claude mcp add rednote-gate --scope user -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js" && echo 'rednote-gate is in dry run: approved items fill the form but never publish. Open a new Claude Code session.'
scripts.approve: node -e "const f=require('path').join(process.env.RN_DATA_DIR||'data','approval-url');try{console.log(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch{console.error('No approval page running. Start the MCP server first.');process.exit(1)}"
